phenomenon_summary: Recurrent CA3 collaterals iteratively complete a stored memory pattern from a partial cue delivered via entorhinal and dentate inputs, with the completed pattern read out by CA1.

units.name: partial_cue
units.description: Degraded sensory/contextual cue representing partial features of a stored memory.

units.name: EC_stellate
units.description: Layer II stellate cells projecting via perforant path to DG and CA3.

units.name: DG
units.description: Dentate gyrus region performing pattern separation.

units.name: DG_granule
units.description: Granule cells; sparse coding, send mossy fibers to CA3.

units.name: DG_mossy
units.description: Mossy cells providing associational excitation within DG.

units.name: CA3_pyramidal
units.description: CA3 pyramidal cells with dense recurrent collaterals; NMDAR-dependent Hebbian plasticity; attractor dynamics.

units.name: CA3_PV_basket
units.description: PV+ basket interneurons providing feedback inhibition to keep CA3 activity sparse.

units.name: CA1_pyramidal
units.description: CA1 pyramidal neurons reading out completed CA3 pattern via Schaffer collaterals.

units.name: recalled_memory
units.description: Reconstructed memory / place-cell representation observed downstream of CA1.

interactions.description: Sensory/contextual cue drives entorhinal layer II.
Perforant path to dentate granule cells.
Direct perforant path to CA3 (weak cue input).
Sparse mossy-fiber detonator synapses onto CA3 pyramidals.
Mossy cell associational feedback within DG.
Recurrent collateral excitation implementing autoassociative attractor (NMDAR-dependent).
Schaffer collateral readout of completed pattern.
CA1 output corresponds to recalled memory representation.

parameters.name: cue_completeness
parameters.role: fraction of original cue features present at input

parameters.name: CA3_recurrent_strength
parameters.value: high in WT, reduced in CA3-NR1 KO

parameters.name: sparsity_target
parameters.role: fraction of active CA3 pyramidals set by PV inhibition

notes: Recurrent CA3-CA3 excitation and CA3<->PV feedback inhibition are the core attractor loop; time_steps=6 to allow iterative convergence. DG mossy/granule loop included as a secondary recurrent motif. CA3-NR1 KO corresponds to weakening the CA3_pyramidal->CA3_pyramidal recurrent weight.
